# unifi_heat_map_point (Data Source)

The `unifi_heat_map_point` data source retrieves an existing heat map point by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_heat_map_point" "example" {
  id = "5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `download_speed` (Number) The measured download speed at this point.
- `heatmap_id` (String) The identifier of the `unifi_heat_map` this point belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `upload_speed` (Number) The measured upload speed at this point.
- `x` (Number) The horizontal position of the point on the map.
- `y` (Number) The vertical position of the point on the map.
